scenicChapters.title: Chuh-Nuur Lake cluster → Mongol Daguur SPNA
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 59 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-caidas-del-salbimec-los-estrechos.story: A 180 km round trip from Valdeltormo - roughly 3 h 06 in the saddle. The stops in between: Valcomuna, Abric del mas de Barberà, Los Estrechos I and back through Abric del mas de Barberà. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Byodo-in → Nara Palace Site
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 30 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-ryoan-ji-fujiwara-palace-site.story: From Kamigyō-ku it runs 165 km to Kamigyō-ku; allow about 2 h 51 of riding. It goes by way of Byodo-in, Nara Palace Site, Fujiwara Palace Site and back through Nara Palace Site. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
